defects.title: The balance check prints ans = [] for every new reaction
defects.trigger: any call that reaches the balance check
defects.observed: "ans =" / "[]" printed once per new reaction: showprogress(i/S_nrxns(1)) on line 142 has no semicolon and showprogress returns []

defects.title: The missing-formula message is never shown; an empty formula raises an index error
defects.trigger: ReactionChecks(rxn, metab, compartments, {'NOF', 'no formula', '', 1, 0}, []) with the tables of the test
defects.observed: error 'Index exceeds array bounds.' at line 144; isempty(newrxns(i,3)) on line 117 tests a 1x1 cell, never empty, so lines 118-122 are dead
defects.expected: the 'is missing the formula' box and output []

defects.title: A metabolite without charged formula raises an error after BalancePrep's message
defects.trigger: metab row {'nochg', 'no charged formula', 'H', '', '0'}; ReactionChecks(rxn, metab, compartments, {'NOC', 'x', 'nochg[c] -> h[c]', 1, 0}, [])
defects.observed: BalancePrep shows 'Reaction cannot be created with metabolites that are missing the charged formula.' and returns []; ReactionChecks then fails at line 150 with 'Brace indexing is not supported for variables of this type.'

defects.title: A new reaction identical to a database reaction leaves an empty row in data
defects.trigger: newrxns ENO2 (2pg[c] -> h2o[c] + pep[c]), ENO_DUP (identical to database ENO), GLCt, PGIe (g6p[c] <=> f6p[e]) against database ENO, PGI
defects.observed: data = {'ENO2', ENO row; [], []; 'PGIe', PGI row} (rows follow the similarity list; the removed reaction's row stays empty)
defects.expected: one data row per remaining new reaction with similar reactions

notes: Happy path (balanced new reactions, similarity listing in data, identical reactions removed with warn box) and the two msgbox error exits (empty abbreviation, duplicate new abbreviations) are tested with hand-built tables; message boxes closed by the test. Exempt: all questdlg / unbalanced-window (uiwait) branches (59-60, 70-112, 145-147, 156, 161-168, 174-181, 187-217, 223-225) and dead lines 118-122 (line 162 also dead: balancecheck(...,1) never returns []). All four defects classified cosmetic (rejected or console-only inputs; the error exits follow invalid input that the code meant to reject with a message) - lead may reclassify the two 'error instead of message' entries as severity error, which would quarantine ReactionChecks and its caller addreactions. Repro of defect 2/3/4 in the header TRIGGER lines (tables of the test). The test removes the WAITBAR_HANDLE global created by showprogress.

notes: Repro (MATLAB): map.specName = {'hk'}; map.specMetaID = {'s5'}; map.specIncName = cell(0, 1); map.specIncID = cell(0, 1); map.molID = {'s5'}; map.molColor = {'ffccff66'}; colorProtein(map, {'hk'})  -> 'The specified key is not present in this container.' Side observation (not recorded as defect): with specIncName/specIncID as 0x0 {} line 41 errors 'Index in position 2 exceeds array bounds'; the documented producer transformFullXML2Map was not checked for that form.

defects.title: Secondary reaction lines are coloured with the undefined function Colors
defects.trigger: map.rxnName = {'R1'}; map.rxnColor = {'ffff0000'}; map.rxnWidth = {'3.0'}; map.rxnReactantLineColor = {{'ffff0000'}}; map.rxnReactantLineWidth = {{'3.0'}}; map.rxnProductLineColor = {''}; map.rxnProductLineWidth = {''}; defaultColorCD(map)
defects.observed: error "Undefined function 'Colors' for input arguments of type 'char'." at line 36 (line 42 for product lines); a map without the line fields returns rxnColor {'ff000000'}, rxnWidth {1}

notes: Repro (MATLAB): map.rxnName = {'R1'}; map.rxnColor = {'ffff0000'}; map.rxnWidth = {'3.0'}; map.rxnReactantLineColor = {{'ffff0000'}}; map.rxnReactantLineWidth = {{'3.0'}}; map.rxnProductLineColor = {''}; map.rxnProductLineWidth = {''}; defaultColorCD(map) -> Undefined function 'Colors' (defaultColorCD:36). Confined to maps with the complete structure (rxnReactantLineColor field, as from transformFullXML2Map) and a non-empty secondary line list; maps from transformXML2Map (no such field) work. No src/ function calls defaultColorCD or colorProtein (grep), so the quarantine blocks no caller.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: line 36/42 calls the undefined function Colors)
